sloka: तदिदं वीर सम्प्राप्तं मया पूर्वं समीरितम् ।काममोहपरीतस्य यत्ते न रुचितं वचः ।। ६.११२.४ ।।
transliteration: tadidaṁ vīra samprāptaṁ mayā pūrvaṁ samīritam ।kāmamohaparītasya yatte na rucitaṁ vacaḥ ।। 6.112.4 ।।

translations.english: "Hero! That which was predicted by me earlier, which did not find your favour due to your infatuation, has come true."
